source_title: 'Ranabaali' BO day 14: Vijay Deverakonda's film falls
source_excerpt: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's period action film 'Ranabaali' has completed 14 days in theaters. The film's worldwide gross collection has reached Rs 78.90 cr. However, its reported production budget remains considerably higher than its current theatrical earnings. The movie collected Rs 95 lakh net in India on Thursday, October 29. According to Sacnilk, the amount came from 1,449 shows across the country.The latest daily collection represents a 5% decline from Wednesday's Rs 1 cr. With this addition, 'Ranabaali' has accumulated Rs 57.30 cr in domestic net collections. Its India gross stands at Rs 66.55 cr. Overseas markets contributed Rs 15 lakh on Thursday, taking the cumulative overseas gross to Rs 12.35 cr. The film's worldwide theatrical gross has consequently reached Rs 78.90 cr. 'Ranabaali' box office collection: Second-week earnings'Ranabaali' opened its second week with Rs 2.10 cr on Friday, October 23. Collections improved over the weekend, with Saturday bringing in Rs 2.80 cr. Sunday registered the second week's highest daily collection of Rs 2.90 cr. The film then experienced a decline during the weekdays.Monday's earnings stood at Rs 1.25 cr, followed by Rs 1.10 cr on Tuesday. Wednesday added Rs 1 cr, while Thursday contributed Rs 95 lakh. The film's second-week collection has reached Rs 12.10 cr so far. This follows its first-week earnings of Rs 45.20 cr.The film recorded 98,911 admissions on Day 14. Its cumulative theatrical footfalls across India have now reached 4,679,624. The latest figures indicate that weekday collections have remained below the weekend levels.'Ranabaali' records 14.03% occupancy on day 14The Telugu movie registered an overall theater occupancy of 14.03% on Thursday. Morning screenings recorded 12.67%, while afternoon shows registered 14.75%. The evening occupancy stood at 14.17%. Night shows recorded 13%.Despite the decline in daily collections, the film continued to attract audiences across its theatrical run. However, its weekday occupancy figures remained lower than the weekend levels recorded earlier in the second week.'Ranabaali' budget and pre-release business detailsAccording to a report by Samayam Telugu, 'Ranabaali' was made on an estimated production budget of Rs 120 cr to Rs 150 cr. Its current worldwide theatrical gross remains below this reported investment. The film therefore has a substantial gap to bridge through its box office performance.The report further states that approximately Rs 30 cr to Rs 60 cr was allocated for the remuneration of actors and technicians. This amount reportedly includes the fees of lead actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna.However, the film had already recovered an estimated Rs 42 cr to Rs 60 cr before its theatrical release. These earnings reportedly came from non-theatrical agreements involving digital streaming and satellite rights. 'Ranabaali' arrived in theaters on October 16, 2026. Such pre-release revenue forms part of its overall business, although the final financial outcome will depend on its complete revenue and expenditure figures.'Ranabaali': Story, setting and cast'Ranabaali' is a Telugu period action epic featuring Vijay Deverakonda in the titular role. Rashmika Mandanna and Arnold Vosloo also feature in the movie. The narrative draws inspiration from the colonial history of 19th-century India and explores resistance against British rule.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized.
